scope: Bounded read-only follow-up of the timeout fix and route-context stop/resource propagation; no Lean, no canonical source/test edits.
observations: Worker _compute translates cooperative TimeoutError from both route preparation and goal checking to status=incomplete, code=timeout.
Parent _prepare/_check invoke recursive _resource_stop before classifying worker results; _resource_stop recognizes timeout code/status at arbitrary nested depth, so later goal stages halt.
The stop path uses _fail and keeps demandDischarged=false; only memory-limit requests memoryReportBackRequired, preserving timeout guidance classification.
Worker main generic rejection remains for invalid worker inputs; operation-local TimeoutError is consumed by _compute.
limitations: Pure mocked stop tests only. No positive runtime, Lean, or full integrated gate was run; root owns those checks.
